ruled_out_vectors.vector: CLOBHelper.calculateFixedInput rounds UP output to makers
ruled_out_vectors.reason: CLOB uses mulDivRoundingUp(amountIn, sqrtPriceX96, Q96) twice, giving makers 1-4 extra wei per fill versus the correct mulDiv. Over 1000 fills, total surplus is ~1700 wei. Per-fill max = 2 wei. Not economically exploitable: placing enough orders to profit costs orders of magnitude more gas than the extracted value. Dust-level per L-012.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: FixedHelper.normalizePriceToRatio zero-component ratio at extreme sqrtPrice
ruled_out_vectors.reason: At MIN_SQRT_RATIO, normalizePriceToRatio produces ratio (1, 0) after simplification. Swaps in one direction get 0 output, other direction reverts on division by zero (FullMath.mulDiv reverts when denominator=0). This makes the pool non-functional at extreme prices but is a self-inflicted config error (FP#4) — pool creator chose the price.

Standard Remco Bloemen implementation with CRT+Newton-Raphson. mulDiv(0, b, d) = 0. mulDiv(a, b, 0) reverts. mulDivRoundingUp >= mulDiv for all inputs. 512-bit intermediate handles phantom overflow correctly. Verified by tests in dynamic pool repo.

Round-trip calculateFixedSwapByRatio(calculateFixedSwapByRatioRoundingDown(amount, ratio, true), ratio, false) >= amount verified at 1:1, 1:1M, 1M:1 ratios and via fuzz testing. Precision loss bounded by floor(den/num) + 2. calculateFixedSwapByRatio always >= calculateFixedSwapByRatioRoundingDown for same inputs.
consumedLiquidityDelta always <= availableLiquidity. Share conservation holds: unconsumedShareDelta + consumed share = original shareDelta. Zero shareDelta returns (0,0). Verified via fuzz testing.
shareDelta always <= currentShare. Returned liquidity <= consumed liquidity. Delta exceeding consumed sets share to zero. Fuzz verified across varied ratios.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: DynamicHelper fee growth tracking across tick crossings
ruled_out_vectors.reason: _crossTick flips feeGrowthOutside using standard Uniswap V3 formula (global - outside). _getFeeGrowthInside correctly computes fee growth inside range using three cases (below/within/above). _updateTick initializes fee growth outside to global values when tick <= current (by convention). All in unchecked blocks for intentional wrapping. Identical to audited Uniswap V3 code.
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Manual code review of DynamicHelper.sol lines 502-629, 756-794

ruled_out_vectors.reason: Protocol fee uses mulDivRoundingUp (rounds against LPs, for protocol). Fee growth increment uses mulDiv (rounds down, any dust stays in pool balance unaccounted — protocol surplus). When liquidity=0, fee is not accumulated (no LP to receive it), and swap produces 0 amounts (price jumps through empty ranges). Standard Uniswap V3 behavior.
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Manual code review of DynamicHelper.sol lines 396-408

ruled_out_vectors.reason: getAmount0Delta/getAmount1Delta with roundUp=true >= roundUp=false. Equal prices produce 0 deltas. getNextSqrtPriceFromInput correctly handles both directions (decrease for zeroForOne, increase for oneForZero). computeRatioX96 returns MIN/MAX_SQRT_RATIO for degenerate inputs (0,N) and (N,0).

amountIn + feeAmount never exceeds amountSpecifiedRemaining. At 1 wei input with 0.3% fee, fee consumes entire input (amountOut=0). At 100 wei input, amountIn + feeAmount <= 100. Verified across 1000 sequential steps.
getTickAtSqrtPrice(getSqrtPriceAtTick(t)) == t for every 1000th tick from MIN_TICK to MAX_TICK, plus boundary ticks (MIN_TICK, MAX_TICK-1, tick 0). Zero mismatches.

Output fee >= input fee for all BPS values (verified by fuzz). This is by design: output uses denominator (MAX_BPS - BPS) which is smaller. Protocol fee never exceeds base fee (mulDiv rounds down). Input allows 100% fee (MAX_BPS), output rejects >= MAX_BPS — intentional asymmetry. 1 wei at 50% BPS rounds fee to 0 (user keeps wei).

Already known and patched (v1 findings). _validatePricingBounds checks for sqrtPriceX96 == 0 and reverts with InvalidPrice. The dynamic scaling loop prevents multiplication overflow of amount1 * multiplier. At extreme inputs (type(uint256).max, 1), overflow check returns 0 which is caught by validators.

Slither flagged _increaseHeight/_decreaseHeight lines 1799/1899 as divide-before-multiply. Actual pattern is standard divmod: heightToMove = remaining / liquidity; remaining -= heightToMove * liquidity. This correctly computes quotient and remainder. Fee distribution in height loops uses diminishing-pool allocation with mulDiv rounding down — last height gets accumulated remainders (dust-level).
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Manual code review of FixedHelper.sol lines 1753-1938

ruled_out_vectors.reason: Swap-by-output allows totalAmountInFilled to exceed amountIn by 1 (line 1680). This is intentional split rounding tolerance. Excess triggers fee recalculation via _calculateOutputLPAndProtocolFee. User overpays at most 1 wei — dust-level.
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Manual code review of FixedHelper.sol lines 1652-1711

ruled_out_vectors.reason: When swap-by-input has unused input after height splitting, the excess becomes LP+protocol fees. Dust bounded by potentialDustForOneOutput (= calculateFixedSwapByRatio(1, ratio, !zeroForOne)), which is 1 unit at 1:1 ratio. Even at extreme ratios, the dust per swap is sub-wei economically.
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Manual code review of FixedHelper.sol lines 1714-1727

ruled_out_vectors.vector: AMMModule partial fill fee adjustment rounding
ruled_out_vectors.reason: exchangeFeeAdjustment uses mulDiv (rounds DOWN), meaning less fee is refunded on partial fill — user overpays slightly. protocolExchangeFeeAdjustment also uses mulDiv (same direction). adjustedAmountSpecified correctly reduced by the sum. Balance check at finalization enforces strict equality.
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Manual code review of AMMModule.sol lines 1413-1427, 2207-2214

ruled_out_vectors.reason: AMMModule FeeHelper deducts exchangeFee + feeOnTop from tokenIn. Pool type deducts poolFeeBPS from remaining (also in tokenIn denomination). All fees transferred from tokenIn balance. Fee growth tracked per-token (feeBalance0/feeBalance1 for the input token). No denomination crossing found.
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Explore agent traced full value flow through AMMModule → FixedPoolType → FeeHelper

ruled_out_vectors.reason: Both pool types round input fees UP (user pays more) and output DOWN (user gets less). Combined with multi-layer fees (exchangeFee + poolFee + feeOnTop), any round-trip A→B→A leaves user with strictly less A. Sequential 1-wei swaps confirmed pool never loses value.
